scope: TD entries only (not green). Flat exit explain: fire within 180s of actual sell OR |pnl-exit| < 5pp. Marks ~65s.
note: Two separate formulas — one per wallet. No unified scheme.

UP.rule: (pc5m >= 5 AND pnl >= +8% AND held >= 30s) OR (armed AND giveback >= 8%)
UP.plain: After MFE>=5%: take strength on pc5m>=5 with +8% OR trail giveback 8% from peak.

DOWN.rule: never-arm: pnl <= -10% for 3 consecutive marks AND pc5m <= -5
DOWN.plain: If never reached +5% MFE: durable deep red with weak 5m tape.

UP.rule: (pc5m >= 8 AND pnl >= +10% AND held >= 30s) OR (armed AND giveback >= 12%)
UP.plain: After MFE>=5%: take stronger tape (pc5m>=8) at +10% OR wider trail giveback 12%.

DOWN.rule: never-arm: after pnl <= -5%, sell when bounce_from_trough >= 8%
DOWN.plain: If never reached +5% MFE: scrape a weak reclaim after dipping -5% (failed bounce style).

runner_up_DOWN.rule: FAILBNC: once bounce>=12% then pnl<=-8 (arm_gate 10 + UP pc8&tp10)
runner_up_DOWN.note: Weaker cover than reclaim; same failed-bounce family.
